chunks: Say: 'It is the blessing and mercy of God; so rejoice in it. It is better than all that you amass.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say is better than worldly wealth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a direct address to the Prophet Muhammad and his progeny (Ahl al-Bayt), highlighting that the spiritual joy derived from divine revelation and the Imams' guidance far surpasses the transient accumulation of worldly wealth. It underscores the concept that true success lies in recognizing the 'Fadl' (special grace) of God manifested through the Prophetic lineage, rather than materialistic pursuits.
